subject: Supplier onboarding: PO routing clarification and SKU mapping
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudforge.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@cloudforge.io
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding: PO issuance & SKU mapping questions

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the quick call earlier. We're ready to complete onboarding but have a couple of items before we can finalize the supplier record in our ERP:

1) We need the PO number to be issued and routed to our accounts-payable inbox (procure@cloudforge.io).
2) The PO CSV you provided lists aggregated line items; our system requires SKU-level mapping for tax and account coding.

I've attached the onboarding form and a sample CSV; can you confirm which PO number we should use and whether Redwood can deliver a SKU-broken PO export?

Attachments: CF-Redwood-Onboarding-Form.pdf (filled), sample_PO_import.csv

Cheers,
Sanjay Patel
Head of Procurement
CloudForge Inc.
---
procure@cloudforge.io
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: PO issuance & SKU mapping questions

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for sending the form. Quick answers up front: we can issue a PO number and route the PO to procure@cloudforge.io, and we can produce a SKU-level export. A couple of clarifying points so the export matches your ERP:

- Which column in your sample CSV must contain the CloudForge SKU vs your internal SKU? (CloudForge typically uses SKU_CODE).
- Do you require separate GL account codes per SKU or is a single GL per PO OK?
- Are there tax/location-specific fields we should include (e.g., tax_region)?

I'll loop in Priyom from procurement to generate a provisional PO number. Laura, can you please confirm the GL tagging policy for new vendors and attach the current PO template?

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudforge.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: PO #RDW-2026-4578 (provisional) and SKU mapping request

Hi Sanjay —

Per Marcus, we've provisionally reserved PO number RDW-2026-4578 for CloudForge onboarding. The PO CSV is attached (PO-Redwood-2026-4578.csv) and includes totals per charge type.

Action items for CloudForge to help us complete import:
- Provide a column that maps your SKU_CODE to the line description in our CSV (we attached CF_SKU_Mapping_v1.xlsx as an example).
- Confirm whether you want us to split the existing aggregated Software line (line 1) into the three SKUs listed in CF_SKU_Mapping_v1.xlsx.
- If you need multiple GL codes, list them per SKU and provide tax_region where applicable.

We can route the finalized PO to procure@cloudforge.io once your SKU mapping is confirmed.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: PO-Redwood-2026-4578.csv, CF_SKU_Mapping_v1.xlsx
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudforge.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@cloudforge.io
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO #RDW-2026-4578 (provisional) and SKU mapping request

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the provisional PO. We've reviewed CF_SKU_Mapping_v1.xlsx and can provide a one-to-one SKU mapping for the three software components. A few notes:

- We need the PO to show split line items for the three SKUs (SF-CORE, SF-API, SF-SUPPORT) rather than a single aggregated Software line. Our importer will reject aggregated rows.
- GL codes: please set GL 5201 for SF-CORE and SF-API, and GL 5203 for SF-SUPPORT. Tax_region is US-CA for the SF-SUPPORT line.
- One small correction: the unit price on line 2 of your CSV is off by a factor of 10 (looks like cents vs dollars). Please confirm before we sign.

Attached: CF_SKU_Mapping_CloudForge.xlsx (filled). Once you update the CSV, route the final PO to procure@cloudforge.io and we'll sign.

Best,
Sanjay
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Finalized PO RDW-2026-4578 (SKU split applied) — routing to CloudForge procure inbox

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for the mapping and the note about the unit price. We've corrected the CSV (attached) to show SKU-level lines:

- Line 1: SF-CORE — qty 1 — unit $18,000 — GL 5201
- Line 2: SF-API — qty 1 — unit $9,500 — GL 5201
- Line 3: SF-SUPPORT — qty 12 — unit $1,250 — GL 5203 — tax_region=US-CA

We've also fixed the cents/dollars error on line 2. The finalized PO (PO-Redwood-2026-4578.csv) is attached and will be routed to procure@cloudforge.io within the hour. Please confirm receipt so we can move to contract signature.

Notes/observations for Redwood internal team (Laura/Vanessa/Ben):
- Recommend adding a short memo to the vendor record indicating the SKU split and the GL mapping to avoid future misallocations.
- Finance (Ben), can you confirm the spend cap that applies to CloudForge for Q4? Marcus, is there any negotiated cap we should be aware of?

Thanks —
Priyom
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: PO-Redwood-2026-4578.csv (final), CF_SKU_Mapping_v1_filled.xlsx
